motion.follow: frame-rate independent damping: lerp(a, b, 1 - exp(-dt * k))
motion.text: split per character, each resolving from blur and offset
motion.webgl: yes, WebGL2 full-viewport canvas + Rive canvases

taste.name: Two clocks and nothing between
taste.trigger: When timing hover feedback against story-telling motion
taste.decision: Chose two separated duration bands, 0.18-0.3s for interface feedback and ~1s for narrative reveals, over a continuous spread of 0.4-0.8s values
taste.reason: Feedback that answers inside 300ms feels like the object responded; story motion that takes a second feels intended; the middle band feels like lag
evidence: durations: 0.18s x5, 0.3s x5, 0.2s x4, 0.25s x2, 1s x4, almost no values between 0.5s and 1s

taste.name: Exponential settle, frame-rate independent
taste.trigger: When an element follows scroll or pointer
taste.decision: Chose exponential easing (1 - 2^(-10t)) for reveals and time-based damping lerp(a, b, 1 - exp(-dt * k)) for follow motion over fixed per-frame lerp factors
taste.reason: Exponential out gets most of the way at once and then settles, so content is legible early; time-based damping moves at the same speed on a 60Hz phone and a 120Hz laptop

taste.name: The construction lines are left in
taste.trigger: When framing a product as designed
taste.decision: Chose visible drafting marks (dashed 1px guides, ruler ticks, bezier handles on the wordmark) over hiding the grid
taste.reason: Showing the measurement makes the claim of care checkable; it reads as engineering, not decoration
evidence: wordmark drawn with anchor points and handles

taste.name: One family for every role
taste.trigger: When setting display, body, labels and buttons
taste.decision: Chose halyard-display-variable at weight 500 for 265 of 354 text nodes over a display/body pairing
taste.reason: With motion and 3D carrying the spectacle, a single family keeps the page from feeling assembled from parts
evidence: families on page: halyard-display-variable 559 nodes, Arial 26 (form defaults)
